tricks: Q1 HOOK (0-34.6): 9 pictures in the first 21 s (avg ~2.3 s each): colonnade duo 0-2.7, film couple 2.7-6.4 (2 shots), lipstick woman 6.4-8.4, staring bystanders 8.4-10.3, centred dinner photo on cream 10.3-14.2, cafe woman 14.2-19.6 (2 shots), film woman with older man 19.6-22.6. No text at all until "Episode 26" at 21.1; the script title then wipes in at 21.5 on "you will learn seven things" and stays 4.3 s across a cut (to 25.4). Intro 27.6-34.6 is a single royal clip (Princess of Wales at Wimbledon) held 7 s, then a 2.4 s fade to white straight into card 1. Hook mixes creator street footage, a film scene and a bystander reaction shot.

Q1: the first picture change after the opening clip lands on a sentence break ("credibility. | Others"), and the white/cream centred photo at 10.3 lands on "what she decides" - visual rhythm follows the sentences.

Q2 HOW A POINT OPENS: the previous clip ends with a caramel flash or a fade to white; the card "N. They ..." is written on in black script, often first over a peach blur that turns white; card held 4.0-4.2 s; the voice never reads the card - it starts the body with a different sentence ("Elegant women ..." in points 1,3,5,7). Point 4 card even starts mid-sentence ("One of | the quickest ways..."). Point 5 card begins with ~1.8 s of silence (235.2-237.0).

Q2 HOW A POINT CLOSES: most points end with a two-line sentence card (serif line + script line) 5-7.6 s long that paraphrases the voice (points 2,3,4,5,6,7: 103.2, 179.6, 225.4, 276.5, 338.2, 374.9), followed by 1-3 more clips; then the next card. Point 7 closes on a creator outfit reel ("cannot be bought or imitated").

Q3 CLIP LENGTHS: FULL clips mostly 3.5-5.5 s; longest single holds: drinking close-up 75.8-83.7 (7.9 s), royal clip 27.6-34.6 (7.0 s), vineyard wine woman 367.0-374.9 (7.9 s), centred couple video 185.3-192.5 (7.2 s), quote split 91.8-103.2 (11.4 s, same reel). Centred still photos 3.9-4.9 s. Rows stay 3.5-6.5 s after the last panel lands. Very short inserts exist (Zendaya 0.3 s at 173.4).

Q4 ROWS: 13 rows (2 or 3 panels; never 4+ despite the machine labels). Background is the caramel gradient (11 rows) or white (2 rows, 231.1 and 419.3). Panels are portrait (about 1/3 width each, 3-panel) or near-square (2-panel), separated by thin caramel gaps. They BUILD one by one ~0.6-0.8 s apart (e.g. 47.7/48.5/49.3; 115.7/116.6/117.2; 129.0/129.8/130.5; 349.2/350.0/350.7) or outer two first and middle last (284.3/285.5; 381.4/382.4; 419.3/420.4). Rows are DIFFERENT women (different creators) with a shared colour/mood (e.g. cream/white outfits), except one row where the middle panel swaps twice while the outer stay (287.2, 288.7). Rows of 3 named women once: unknown woman of colour + Angelina Jolie + Princess of Wales (231.1-235.2).

Q5 SMALL TEXT: no creator credits, no @handles, no tip notes, no product names anywhere. Only text: Episode/title, point cards, sentence cards, the split-screen text, quote panel, guide text, logo watermark and end logo. Typos left in: "It'a about giving yourself" (64.1) and "Stylist & Elegance Gyides" (122.6).

Q6 NAMED WOMEN: always full screen video or a centred photo / row panel, never labelled with a name: Princess of Wales (27.6-34.6 video 7 s; 214.2-218.5 centred photo 4.3 s; 232.7-235.2 row panel; 321.3-326.0 video 4.7 s), Marilyn Monroe (166.9-173.4 b&w archive 6.5 s; 353.8-358.9 film 5.1 s), Audrey Hepburn (392.6-399.7 film, 3 shots), Amal Clooney (311.9-316.7, nameplate only from the footage), Angelina Jolie (row panel 231.9-235.2), Zendaya (173.4-179.6), Jennifer Aniston/Lisa Kudrow (42.8-47.7 Friends scene; 267.6-276.5 interview). Named women appear in roughly every point.

Q7 DO/DON'T: no side-by-side do/don't, no ticks/crosses, no before/after. Contrast is done only by choosing a "don't" scene (gossiping on the phone 209.1, Friends women chattering 42.8, emotional interview 268.7) next to calm elegant women.

Q8 GUIDE MENTION: placed after point 2 (115.7-134.7, ~1:56) and again in the outro (426.8-441.5).
